monster:Lord Carnarvon.visualDescription: A tall gray-suited explorer wears a pale brimmed hat, red neckerchief, and dark boots, holding a rectangular case.
monster:Lord Carnarvon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Lord Carnarvon as the Archeologist quest leader.
monster:Lord Carnarvon.modelBrief: Build an older expedition patron in gray coat and hat, red scarf, boots, and hand case; keep his upright formal stance.

monster:Pelias.visualDescription: A broad-shouldered fighter with long dark hair carries a large gray axe, brown armor, and blue-gray trousers.
monster:Pelias.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Pelias as the Barbarian quest leader with strong weapon attacks.
monster:Pelias.modelBrief: Sculpt an imposing barbarian elder with long hair, rugged brown armor, oversized axe, and heavy boots.

monster:Shaman Karnov.visualDescription: A bearded elder in pale wide-brimmed headgear and rust-red robe holds a crooked staff, with exposed tan arms.
monster:Shaman Karnov.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Shaman Karnov as the Cave Dweller quest leader.
monster:Shaman Karnov.modelBrief: Build a stocky tribal shaman with pale cap, broad beard, reddish garment, and branched wooden staff.

monster:Earendil.visualDescription: A golden-haired elf in blue-gray armor stands with an orange shield, dark cloak, and thin sword.
monster:Earendil.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki records Earendil as the former male Elf quest leader in older NetHack versions.
monster:Earendil.modelBrief: Model a tall golden-haired elven leader with blue armor, warm round shield, slender sword, and dark cloak; label as legacy quest art.

monster:Elwing.visualDescription: A dark-haired woman wears a pale gray robe and darker apronlike panel, standing calmly with hands near her sides.
monster:Elwing.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki's Elf quest page identifies Elwing as the former female Elf quest leader.
monster:Elwing.modelBrief: Build a restrained elven noblewoman with dark shoulder-length hair, pale layered dress, and dark waist panel; keep her distinct from Earendil.

monster:Hippocrates.visualDescription: A blond bearded man in long indigo-blue robes stands with one hand lifted and pale underlayers visible.
monster:Hippocrates.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Hippocrates as the Healer quest leader, who uses clerical spells.
monster:Hippocrates.modelBrief: Sculpt a learned healer with blond beard, blue robe, pale inner garment, and an open teaching gesture.

monster:King Arthur.visualDescription: A crowned bearded king wears gold armor and a deep red cape, raising a long silver sword beside a dark shield.
monster:King Arthur.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies King Arthur as the Knight quest leader with two strong weapon attacks.
monster:King Arthur.modelBrief: Build a regal armored king with gold crown, red mantle, long sword, and shield; keep the broad authoritative silhouette.

monster:Grand Master.visualDescription: An elderly bald man in brown-orange robes stands with arms crossed or held inside sleeves, with a long beard.
monster:Grand Master.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Grand Master as the Monk quest leader.
monster:Grand Master.modelBrief: Model an aged martial arts master with wrapped brown robe, long white beard, calm posture, and no prominent weapon.

monster:Arch Priest.visualDescription: A pale-haired cleric wears ornate magenta and gold vestments and holds a gold-topped staff.
monster:Arch Priest.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Arch Priest as the Priest or Cleric quest leader, similar in abilities to a high cleric.
monster:Arch Priest.modelBrief: Sculpt a senior cleric in bright gold-trimmed purple robe, white stole, tall headdress, and ceremonial staff.

monster:Orion.visualDescription: A red-hooded huntsman in rust clothing carries a tall curved bow and dark belt, standing with a broad stance.
monster:Orion.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Orion as the Ranger quest leader and a powerful human combatant.
monster:Orion.modelBrief: Build a seasoned archer with red hood, ochre leather layers, large bow, boots, and broad shoulders.

monster:Master of Thieves.visualDescription: A dark-haired man in simple brown tunic and trousers holds a short blade, one arm bent in a guarded pose.
monster:Master of Thieves.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Master of Thieves as the Rogue quest leader.
monster:Master of Thieves.modelBrief: Model a wary human thief leader with dark hair, brown sleeveless clothes, a short blade, and practical boots.

monster:Lord Sato.visualDescription: A gray-haired elder in long tan robes holds a dark sheathed or drawn sword, with a dark sash and calm stance.
monster:Lord Sato.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Lord Sato as the Samurai quest leader with two weapon attacks.
monster:Lord Sato.modelBrief: Sculpt an older samurai lord with pale hair, layered tan robes, dark sash, and long sword; emphasize composure over motion.
